title: Anti-Poaching in Tanzania: What Has Changed
excerpt: Poaching hit Tanzania's elephants hard in the early 2010s. What has been done since, and how tourism helps.
body:
## The crisis

In the late 2000s and early 2010s, Tanzania lost a large share of its elephants to poaching, especially in the south.

## Response

Stronger law enforcement, intelligence-led operations, ranger training and international cooperation.

## Results

Reports since then indicate poaching has fallen and some populations are stabilising or recovering.

## Rhinos

Intensive protection in Ngorongoro, Mkomazi and the Serengeti.

## Tourism

Tourism income supports rangers and gives value to living animals.

## Your role

Never buy ivory or wildlife products.
